blurb: Apple Hill Golf Club offers an 18-hole course built in 1981 with bentgrass greens and Bermuda grass fairways, featuring water hazards on more than half the holes and out of bounds stakes on six holes. The par 3 course has nine holes and can be played in approximately 45 minutes. The club also hosts golf outings with a deck overlooking the course and a large tent for up to 200 people.
